מודל בייסיאני היררכי: התמיכה בכל מפלגה ה: Hierarchical Bayesian model: each party's support is a time series that drifts at a rate learned from the data, separately per party, with the rates shrunk toward a shared industry-wide level (a list with a short history borrows strength from the others instead of being clipped by hand). A list that entered mid-series is measured only from the polls after its entry: polls that did not ask about it, and the first week after entry, are not treated as data about it. Each pollster gets a learned house effect - its systematic lean relative to the rest - which is netted out. Every poll is weighted by sample size, and extra noise is learned per pollster. The output is not a single number but thousands of possible election-day scenarios

Historically this pollster was closer on Likud in 3 of 4 elections, but by gaps of 1-2 seats - a gap of this size has no precedent. So the model takes half the gap as the mean, and attaches uncertainty the size of that half: the truth may lie anywhere between the two schools. The gap is recomputed on every run
במפלגות שבהן המכונים חלוקים היום לשתי אס: for parties on which pollsters are currently split into two schools. Both sources enter as a distribution, not a number: each party gets a standard deviation measured from the spread across elections, and the midpoint gets uncertainty of its own size
